settings.title: Sizing & fit
settings.content:
How does it fit?
Relaxed and waist-length, with dropped shoulders - easy to layer, easy to live in.

I'm between sizes. Up or down?
Size up. This is a piece you reach for on the soft days, and a little extra room only makes it more of a hug.

Do the hoodie and crewneck fit the same?
Yes. Same pattern, same fabric, same proportions - the crewneck is simply the hoodie without the hood.

Is there a size guide?
There is, on every product page, with flat measurements for each size.

settings.title: Fabric & care
settings.content:
What's it made of?
8.9 oz heavyweight fleece - 80% organic combed ring-spun cotton, 20% recycled polyester.

Is it really organic?
Yes, and independently verified. We carry GOTS, OCS, and GRS certifications.

Why no drawstring?
On purpose. A drawstring is one more thing to fuss with on a day you don't have the energy for fussing.

How do I care for it?
Cold wash, inside-out. Tumble dry low or lay it flat.

settings.title: Give Comfort
settings.content:
How does Give Comfort work?
At checkout, choose the hoodie or the crewneck, write a few words, and add their address. We ship it directly to them with a hand-written card.

Will they see the price?
Never. No pricing, no invoice, no packing slip travels with a Give Comfort order.

Can I stay anonymous?
You can. Sign the note however you like, or leave it unsigned.

Can you ship to a hospital?
Yes. Add the room or unit details in the address and we'll get it there.

settings.title: Orders & shipping
settings.content:
When will my order ship?
Most orders ship within 2 business days.

Is shipping free?
Free on orders over $75 in the US. Flat rate for orders under that.

Do you ship internationally?
Yes, to most countries. Duties and taxes are shown at checkout.

Can I change my address?
Yes, if your order hasn't shipped yet. Email me right away.

settings.title: Returns & guarantee
settings.content:
What is the 30-Day Comfort Guarantee?
If it doesn't feel right, return it within 30 days. No questions asked, no restocking fee.

How do I start a return?
Email me directly and I'll take care of it.

Comfort you have to argue for isn't comfort.
